images.prompt: Night in this kitchen. He sits at the table in the dark, only his phone screen lights his face with a cold blue glow, he stares at the screen with wide surprised eyes. City lights in the window.
In this room he lies on the sofa, excitedly tapping the phone with both thumbs, tongue out from concentration, legs kicking in the air.
In this room he stands frozen in shock, the phone in his hand glows red, a sweat drop on his head, mouth open, dramatic red rim light.

Flashback in spring: a park bench under blossoming cherry trees, sunny day. He sits on the bench, bored, lazily swiping a half-filled form away on his phone, then looks away at a passing ice-cream cart. Soft warm nostalgic film look.
Evening in this room. He sits at a desk with a determined, cunning smile, typing a message on the phone, a desk lamp lights him, a mug of tea next to him.
At the checkout of this store. He holds his phone up to a payment terminal with a square code on its screen, a friendly cashier behind the counter, shopping bag with groceries.
Outside this store at the door, he looks at his phone disappointed, shoulders down, a grey cloud above his head, groceries in the other hand.
At the checkout of this store. He confidently taps a bright yellow plastic bank card on the payment terminal, winking, the terminal shows a green light.
Morning in this kitchen, sunlight through the window. He jumps high with joy holding the phone up, golden coins flying around him, huge happy smile.
In this room he stands next to a big empty whiteboard and points at it with a smart confident face, a marker in the other hand. The whiteboard is completely blank.
Close-up medium shot in this kitchen: he waves at the viewer with a cheeky smile, looking straight into the camera, warm light.
